axes.model_access: The model family is disclosed via official release notes and routed by subscription tier: the 2026-10-13 entry states Gemini 4 Argon rolling out globally to Google AI Pro & Ultra subscribers; free and paid tiers get different models — per the release notes.
axes.runtime: Web is the main entry; official desktop apps exist — a Windows app (release notes 2026-09-10, Alt+Space to summon) and a macOS app (2026-07-29 voice-creation entry, 2026-10-13 Antigravity coding entry); generation is processed on Google's cloud.
axes.local_files: Supports multimodal input and file uploads; the official privacy notice states Google does not train directly on your Gmail/Drive/Photos source libraries, but summaries, excerpts and inferences produced during answering are used for training (Connected Apps personalization page).
axes.background: Chats return instantly; the Skills feature (release notes 2026-09-30) is a reusable instruction set with automatic matching/triggering, but there is no official statement of an "offline continuation" form.
axes.tools: Google ecosystem integration (Search, Workspace, Chrome) is the main selling point; Connected Apps can connect third-party tools (incl. MCP server tools, official help page 16836988); the Gemini macOS app embeds the Antigravity coding agent (2026-10-13).
axes.context: Has memory and personalization; Gems (custom instructions) are being replaced by Skills and migrate automatically (release notes 2026-09-30). The full boundary of cross-session memory is per the official help pages.
axes.permissions: Official Gemini Apps privacy notice (updated 2026-10-13): with Keep Activity on, prompts, generated content and feedback are used to improve Google services (incl. training generative models); with it off, future chats are not used for training (unless you submit feedback); temporary chats and activity-recording-off data are kept 72 hours and not used for training; human reviewers review some data — the official notice warns against entering confidential information.
axes.fit: For people already working inside the Google ecosystem — the integration is a real advantage. For training concerns, turn off Keep Activity; for confidential content, follow the official warning and don't enter it. For running models locally or swapping models freely, closed cloud assistants like this are not suitable.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to chat products).
